summary: require a security section for sensitive plans
pull_request_body: This change adds a security section requirement for plans that touch security triggers.
why: Issue #3247: security and scope questions are left to the model, so plan reviews and fixes returned findings that needed a person. A deterministic trigger and a non-blank security section make the plan answer what crosses a trust boundary, what a person must confirm, and what test fails if the rule breaks.
what_changes: Refuse a plan that changes `SECURITY.md` with no security text in `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py`.
existing_tool: The change adds about 90 lines to `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` at a cost of 30k tokens and 4 hours to build, keep and fix.

added.name: Require security section for sensitive plans
added.text: The proposal check SHALL refuse a plan that names a security trigger and holds no security text.

scenarios.then: The check returns a security problem
